title: Ordinary (OFF) turns have no source-change baseline, so EO's content_comparison path is dead: wire an ordinary baseline or delete it
outcome: Exactly one of two decided outcomes holds, and no dead content_comparison path remains. (a) An ordinary observed turn's recorded closing sighting becomes the claim's baseline for its next turn, so EO reports a measured content_comparison or no change. (b) The content_comparison/baseline path and runtime_checkpoint are deleted, and the EO docs state that ordinary turns report assumed_missing_baseline.
acceptance: The decision between wiring the ordinary baseline and deleting the dead content_comparison path is recorded on this item, with the coordinators' concurrence (Termal::Fable2; Engram::Fable for the w-89f3b3eeb688 evaluation design)

If wired: after an ordinary turn whose closing source sighting was recorded under a claim, the next turn's unadmitted_turn report carries content_comparison against that baseline when the source changed and no source_change when it did not; uncertain attribution, an unrecorded or refused sighting, or a changed claim, binding or named-root generation never becomes the baseline; a focused test pins promotion and non-promotion

If deleted: no product code builds content_comparison or reads runtime_checkpoint, persisted historical values still load, and docs/features describing EO source_change say ordinary turns report assumed_missing_baseline
Under Greg's no-legacy rule the path does not stay dead either way

completion.summary: Option (a): an ordinary turn's recorded closing sighting becomes the claim's baseline for its next turn, so EO reports a measured content_comparison or no change. Landed in 2707075c.
